candidates.title: Prepare a review queue for travel orders and purchases

demandEvidence.chore: Administrate travel orders and purchases, with staff retaining approval of bookings and spending.

ease.reason: A beginner can test an operator-entered request table; n8n documents connecting apps and moving data, but no travel workflow template is attached.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an office handling repeat travel orders may value a review queue; the vacancy shows human work, not AI-tool demand or willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can format fictional requests into a review queue using connected apps; notice fields, procurement rules and system access are unspecified.

autonomy.reason: A trigger could format each supplied request and flag blanks; n8n supports connected workflows, while a person must verify bookings, prices and purchases.

evidence.reason: The fresh vacancy explicitly names travel orders and purchasing; it gives no frequency, input schema or corroboration, and establishes no AI demand.

candidates.reason: Assessed a bounded experiment: format fictional operator-entered travel and purchase requests into a review queue for staff approval. n8n documents app connections and data movement, but not this workflow. Mean 5.2 is below threshold 6; no post proposed.

rejected.title: Administrator role without a stated task
rejected.reason: The fresh paid notice identifies an administrator vacancy but its supplied text contains no concrete task. Without task evidence, a useful chore or safe bounded experiment cannot be specified; no candidate or post is scored.

steps.message: One enriched professional-services notice states travel orders and purchasing; assessed a fictional-input review-queue experiment with n8n app-connection evidence. Its equal-weight mean is 5.2, below 6. The other selected notice has no task excerpt, so the batch proposes no posts.
